subject.title: refactor(channels): migrate googlechat, imessage, and whatsapp group policy onto the scope tree

question: Should the scope-tree resolver become a permanent public Plugin SDK contract before every bundled group-policy caller has migrated?
rationale: Choosing whether to expose a parallel long-lived SDK family, temporarily deprecate the old family, or keep the new implementation internal determines an external compatibility contract and cannot be inferred safely from tests.

options.title: Complete one-path migration
options.body: Keep the new resolver internal until bundled callers migrate, then expose one canonical public API with any required deprecation bridge.

options.title: Approve temporary parallel APIs
options.body: Publish both families with an explicit compatibility rationale, deprecation schedule, removal owner, documentation, and focused external-plugin tests.

options.title: Pause the scope-tree stack
options.body: Do not land the migration until the public API direction and stacked branch structure are reconsidered.

recommendation.title: Complete one-path migration
recommendation.body: Keep the new resolver internal until bundled callers migrate, then expose one canonical public API with any required deprecation bridge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the resolver design and all supplied migration-stack commits, making them the best available owner for clarifying its intended contract.
